description: Sidebar Color Selector - Add 7 color swatches (6 predefined + 1 dynamic current color) and an eyedropper tool to the resume editor page for quick sidebar color customization.

userStories.title: Add 6 predefined color swatches for sidebar
userStories.description: As a user, I want to quickly choose from predefined colors to personalize my resume sidebar.
acceptanceCriteria: Add 6 clickable color swatches below the existing color slider
Colors are exactly: #2C3E50, #243A5E, #333333, #5C6F91, #2A7F7F, #1F3A5F
Clicking a swatch immediately applies the color to the sidebar
No confirmation dialog or delay required
Swatches are circular or square with clear visual boundaries
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Added 6 circular color swatches (lines 1146-1193) below color slider. Each swatch updates sidebarHue and sidebarBrightness on click. Hover effects and active state indicator included.

userStories.title: Add 7th dynamic swatch showing current sidebar color
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see the current sidebar color as a swatch so I can reference or re-select it.
acceptanceCriteria: 7th swatch displays the current sidebar color
Swatch updates in real-time when color changes (via slider, preset, or eyedropper)
Visually distinguished from predefined swatches (e.g., border, label, or checkmark)
Clicking it re-applies the current color (no-op but consistent behavior)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Added 7th swatch (lines 1193-1234) using sidebarColor variable. Dashed border, white checkmark SVG, always-on selection ring for visual distinction. Click handler re-applies current values.

userStories.title: Align color swatches with existing slider width
userStories.description: As a user, I want a clean visual integration where swatches align perfectly with the slider.
acceptanceCriteria: All 7 swatches are positioned directly below the existing color slider
Total width of swatches matches the slider width exactly
Swatches are evenly spaced and horizontally aligned
No visual overflow or misalignment
Responsive behavior maintained on different screen sizes
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Container uses width:100% and space-between. Swatches use flex:1 with min/max constraints. SWATCH_BASE_STYLE constant for DRY. CSS-only hover via globals.css. 7th swatch is button for accessibility.

userStories.title: Add eyedropper tool for screen color picking
userStories.description: As an advanced user, I want to pick any color visible on my screen to use for the sidebar.
acceptanceCriteria: Add eyedropper/pipette icon button near the color controls
Clicking activates the browser's native EyeDropper API (if supported)
Selected color is immediately applied to the sidebar
7th swatch (current color) updates to reflect the picked color
Graceful fallback or hidden button if EyeDropper API is not supported
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Created eyedropper.d.ts for TypeScript types. Added Pipette icon, isEyeDropperSupported state, hexToHsl converter, handleEyedropperClick handler. Button hidden in unsupported browsers.

userStories.title: Ensure real-time color application without page reload
userStories.description: As a user, I want all color changes to apply instantly to the sidebar preview.
acceptanceCriteria: Color changes from slider update sidebar in real-time (existing behavior preserved)
Color changes from predefined swatches update sidebar instantly
Color changes from eyedropper update sidebar instantly
No page reload or 'Apply' button required
Sidebar preview reflects the exact hex color selected
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
